## Dim1

```{R}
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Medical Density Analysis (Taipei, New Taipei, Hsinchu City/County)
# Script: medical_facilitate_4regions_eng.R
# Features:
#   1. Covers 4 Regions: Taipei, New Taipei, Hsinchu City, Hsinchu County.
#   2. Full English translation for all districts in these regions.
#   3. GitHub-friendly 'here' paths & output folder generation.
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Setup & Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(readr, dplyr, stringr, ggplot2, here)

# Create 'output' directory
output_dir <- here("output")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Comprehensive English Translation Index
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Region & Level Mapping
common_map <- c(
  "臺北市" = "Taipei City",
  "新北市" = "New Taipei City",
  "新竹市" = "Hsinchu City",
  "新竹縣" = "Hsinchu County",
  
  "醫學中心" = "Medical Center",
  "區域醫院" = "Regional Hospital",
  "地區醫院" = "Local Hospital",
  "診所"     = "Clinic",
  "藥局"     = "Pharmacy"
)

# B. District Mapping (Taipei + New Taipei + Hsinchu)
district_map <- c(
  # --- Hsinchu County (Updated: Hukou, Xinfeng, Qionglin added) ---
  "竹北市" = "Zhubei City",      "竹東鎮" = "Zhudong Township",
  "新埔鎮" = "Xinpu Township",   "關西鎮" = "Guanxi Township",
  "湖口鄉" = "Hukou Township",   "新豐鄉" = "Xinfeng Township",
  "芎林鄉" = "Qionglin Township","橫山鄉" = "Hengshan Township",
  "北埔鄉" = "Beipu Township",   "寶山鄉" = "Baoshan Township",
  "峨眉鄉" = "Emei Township",    "尖石鄉" = "Jianshi Township",
  "五峰鄉" = "Wufeng Township",
  
  # --- Hsinchu City ---
  "東區"   = "East Dist.", "北區" = "North Dist.", "香山區" = "Xiangshan Dist.",
  
  # --- Taipei City (12 Districts) ---
  "中正區" = "Zhongzheng Dist.", "大同區" = "Datong Dist.",
  "中山區" = "Zhongshan Dist.",  "松山區" = "Songshan Dist.",
  "大安區" = "Da'an Dist.",      "萬華區" = "Wanhua Dist.",
  "信義區" = "Xinyi Dist.",      "士林區" = "Shilin Dist.",
  "北投區" = "Beitou Dist.",     "內湖區" = "Neihu Dist.",
  "南港區" = "Nangang Dist.",    "文山區" = "Wenshan Dist.",
  
  # --- New Taipei City (Major Districts) ---
  "板橋區" = "Banqiao Dist.",    "三重區" = "Sanchong Dist.",
  "中和區" = "Zhonghe Dist.",    "永和區" = "Yonghe Dist.",
  "新莊區" = "Xinzhuang Dist.",  "新店區" = "Xindian Dist.",
  "土城區" = "Tucheng Dist.",    "蘆洲區" = "Luzhou Dist.",
  "汐止區" = "Xizhi Dist.",      "樹林區" = "Shulin Dist.",
  "淡水區" = "Tamsui Dist.",     "鶯歌區" = "Yingge Dist.",
  "三峽區" = "Sanxia Dist.",     "五股區" = "Wugu Dist.",
  "泰山區" = "Taishan Dist.",    "林口區" = "Linkou Dist.",
  "深坑區" = "Shenkeng Dist.",   "石碇區" = "Shiding Dist.",
  "坪林區" = "Pinglin Dist.",    "三芝區" = "Sanzhi Dist.",
  "石門區" = "Shimen Dist.",     "八里區" = "Bali Dist.",
  "平溪區" = "Pingxi Dist.",     "雙溪區" = "Shuangxi Dist.",
  "貢寮區" = "Gongliao Dist.",   "金山區" = "Jinshan Dist.",
  "萬里區" = "Wanli Dist.",      "烏來區" = "Wulai Dist.",
  "瑞芳區" = "Ruifang Dist."
)

# Helper function
translate_text <- function(x, map) {
  res <- map[x]
  # If translation missing, return original Chinese so we notice it
  ifelse(is.na(res), x, res) 
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Loading data...\n")

# Use 'here' for paths
file_med_center <- here("data", "medical_facilities", "medical_center_202510.csv")
file_regional   <- here("data", "medical_facilities", "hospital_regional_202510.csv")
file_local      <- here("data", "medical_facilities", "hospital_local_202510.csv")
file_clinic     <- here("data", "medical_facilities", "clinic_202510.csv")
file_pharmacy   <- here("data", "medical_facilities", "pharmacy_202510.csv")

safe_read_csv <- function(path, level_label) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Level_Chi = level_label)
}

df_all <- bind_rows(
  safe_read_csv(file_med_center, "醫學中心"),
  safe_read_csv(file_regional,   "區域醫院"),
  safe_read_csv(file_local,      "地區醫院"),
  safe_read_csv(file_clinic,     "診所"),
  safe_read_csv(file_pharmacy,   "藥局")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Data Processing (4 Regions)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Processing 4 Regions (Taipei, New Taipei, Hsinchu City/County)...\n")

df_processed <- df_all %>%
  # 1. Filter for all 4 regions
  filter(str_detect(地址, "臺北市|新北市|新竹市|新竹縣")) %>%
  mutate(
    # 2. Extract Region (Normalized)
    Region_Chi = case_when(
      str_detect(地址, "臺北市") ~ "臺北市",
      str_detect(地址, "新北市") ~ "新北市",
      str_detect(地址, "新竹市") ~ "新竹市",
      str_detect(地址, "新竹縣") ~ "新竹縣",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # 3. Extract District using Regex
    District_Chi = str_match(地址, "(臺北市|新北市|新竹市|新竹縣)([^縣市區鄉鎮]+[市區鄉鎮])")[, 3]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(District_Chi)) %>%
  
  # 4. TRANSLATION
  mutate(
    Region   = translate_text(Region_Chi, common_map),
    District = translate_text(District_Chi, district_map),
    Level    = translate_text(Level_Chi, common_map)
  ) %>%
  
  # 5. Set Logic Order for Factors (North -> South / Hierarchy)
  mutate(
    Level = factor(Level, levels = c("Medical Center", "Regional Hospital", "Local Hospital", "Clinic", "Pharmacy")),
    # Order: Taipei -> New Taipei -> Hsinchu City -> Hsinchu County
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Taipei City", "New Taipei City", "Hsinchu City", "Hsinchu County"))
  ) %>%
  
  # 6. Count
  group_by(Region, District, Level) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  
  # 7. Calculate Totals for Plot Sorting
  group_by(Region, District) %>%
  mutate(DistrictTotal = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Plot 1: Key Hospitals (All 4 Regions) ---
cat("Generating Plot 1: Key Hospitals (All Regions)...\n")
data_hospitals <- df_processed %>%
  filter(Level %in% c("Medical Center", "Regional Hospital", "Local Hospital"))

if(nrow(data_hospitals) > 0) {
  p1 <- ggplot(data_hospitals, aes(x = reorder(District, -DistrictTotal), y = Count, fill = Level)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", size = 2.5) +
    
    # Facet by Region (Free scales allows each region to have its own district list)
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Key Medical Facilities Distribution (Taipei Metro & Hsinchu)",
      subtitle = "Medical Centers, Regional & Local Hospitals",
      x = NULL, # Hide x label to save space
      y = "Number of Facilities",
      fill = "Facility Level",
      caption = "Source: Open Data | PBAG2 Project"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8), # Vertical text for many districts
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
  
  print(p1)
  ggsave(here("output", "AllRegions_Hospitals_Eng.png"), p1, width = 14, height = 10, bg = "white")
}

# --- Plot 2: Primary Care (All 4 Regions) ---
cat("Generating Plot 2: Primary Care (All Regions)...\n")
data_primary <- df_processed %>%
  filter(Level %in% c("Clinic", "Pharmacy"))

if(nrow(data_primary) > 0) {
  p2 <- ggplot(data_primary, aes(x = reorder(District, -DistrictTotal), y = Count, fill = Level)) +
    geom_col() +
    
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Primary Care Resources (Taipei Metro & Hsinchu)",
      subtitle = "Clinics and Pharmacies",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Count",
      fill = "Type",
      caption = "Source: Open Data | PBAG2 Project"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
  
  print(p2)
  ggsave(here("output", "AllRegions_PrimaryCare_Eng.png"), p2, width = 14, height = 10, bg = "white")
}

cat("\nDone! Check the 'output' folder for 4-region charts.\n")
```

```{R}
#12221101
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Real Estate & Medical Analysis (English Report Version)
# Focus: 
#   1. Combined Plot (All Regions)
#   2. Individual Plots (Taipei, New Taipei, Hsinchu County)
#   3. Skip Hsinchu City Plot (with Note)
#   4. Bubble Size = Aging Index
#   5. English Labels for all Districts
# ==============================================================================

rm(list = ls()) # Clear environment

# Load required packages
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "ggrepel", "here", "scales")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 0. Define Translation Index (Chinese -> English)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 為了英文報告，我們先定義好翻譯字典
region_map <- c(
  "臺北市" = "Taipei City",
  "新北市" = "New Taipei City",
  "新竹市" = "Hsinchu City",
  "新竹縣" = "Hsinchu County"
)

# 常見行政區翻譯 (可根據實際資料擴充)
district_map <- c(
  # Taipei
  "中正區"="Zhongzheng", "大同區"="Datong", "中山區"="Zhongshan", "松山區"="Songshan", 
  "大安區"="Da'an", "萬華區"="Wanhua", "信義區"="Xinyi", "士林區"="Shilin", 
  "北投區"="Beitou", "內湖區"="Neihu", "南港區"="Nangang", "文山區"="Wenshan",
  # New Taipei (部分主要區域，若有缺漏會顯示原名或拼音)
  "板橋區"="Banqiao", "三重區"="Sanchong", "中和區"="Zhonghe", "永和區"="Yonghe", 
  "新莊區"="Xinzhuang", "新店區"="Xindian", "樹林區"="Shulin", "鶯歌區"="Yingge", 
  "三峽區"="Sanxia", "淡水區"="Tamsui", "汐止區"="Xizhi", "瑞芳區"="Ruifang",
  "土城區"="Tucheng", "蘆洲區"="Luzhou", "五股區"="Wugu", "泰山區"="Taishan",
  "林口區"="Linkou", "深坑區"="Shenkeng", "石碇區"="Shiding", "坪林區"="Pinglin",
  "三芝區"="Sanzhi", "石門區"="Shimen", "八里區"="Bali", "平溪區"="Pingxi",
  "雙溪區"="Shuangxi", "貢寮區"="Gongliao", "金山區"="Jinshan", "萬里區"="Wanli", "烏來區"="Wulai",
  # Hsinchu City
  "新竹市"="Hsinchu City", # Aggregated
  # Hsinchu County
  "竹北市"="Zhubei", "竹東鎮"="Zhudong", "新埔鎮"="Xinpu", "關西鎮"="Guanxi", 
  "湖口鄉"="Hukou", "新豐鄉"="Xinfeng", "芎林鄉"="Qionglin", "橫山鄉"="Hengshan", 
  "北埔鄉"="Beipu", "寶山鄉"="Baoshan", "峨眉鄉"="Emei", "尖石鄉"="Jianshi", "五峰鄉"="Wufeng"
)

translate_district <- function(name) {
  if (name %in% names(district_map)) return(district_map[name])
  return(name) # Return original if not found
}

translate_region <- function(name) {
  if (name %in% names(region_map)) return(region_map[name])
  return(name)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 1. Process Medical Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
safe_read_csv <- function(file_path, level_name) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) stop(paste("File not found:", file_path))
  read_csv(file_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(Level = level_name)
}

df_med <- bind_rows(
  safe_read_csv(here("data/medical_facilities/medical_center_202510.csv"), "Medical Center"),
  safe_read_csv(here("data/medical_facilities/hospital_regional_202510.csv"), "Regional Hospital"),
  safe_read_csv(here("data/medical_facilities/hospital_local_202510.csv"), "Local Hospital"),
  safe_read_csv(here("data/medical_facilities/clinic_202510.csv"), "Clinic"),
  safe_read_csv(here("data/medical_facilities/pharmacy_202510.csv"), "Pharmacy")
)

medical_summary <- df_med %>%
  filter(str_detect(地址, "臺北市|新北市|新竹市|新竹縣")) %>%
  mutate(
    Region_Chi = case_when(
      str_detect(地址, "臺北市") ~ "臺北市",
      str_detect(地址, "新北市") ~ "新北市",
      str_detect(地址, "新竹市") ~ "新竹市",
      str_detect(地址, "新竹縣") ~ "新竹縣",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Raw_District = str_match(地址, "(臺北市|新北市|新竹市|新竹縣)([^縣市區鄉鎮]+[市區鄉鎮])")[, 3]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region_Chi) & !is.na(Raw_District)) %>%
  mutate(
    District_Chi = if_else(Region_Chi == "新竹市", "新竹市", Raw_District)
  ) %>%
  count(Region_Chi, District_Chi, Level) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 2. Process Real Estate Data (LVR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
read_lvr <- function(path, region_chi) {
  p1 <- here(path)
  p2 <- here("data", path)
  target <- if(file.exists(p1)) p1 else if(file.exists(p2)) p2 else NULL
  
  if (is.null(target)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(target, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Region_Chi = region_chi)
}

df_lvr <- bind_rows(
  read_lvr("data/lvr_landcsv114Q3/a_lvr_land_a.csv", "臺北市"),
  read_lvr("data/lvr_landcsv114Q3/f_lvr_land_a.csv", "新北市"), 
  read_lvr("data/lvr_landcsv114Q3/o_lvr_land_a.csv", "新竹市"),
  read_lvr("data/lvr_landcsv114Q3/j_lvr_land_a.csv", "新竹縣")
)

lvr_summary <- df_lvr %>%
  filter(`交易標的` == "房地(土地+建物)", `主要用途` == "住家用") %>%
  mutate(
    Price_Per_M2 = as.numeric(`單價元平方公尺`),
    District_Chi = `鄉鎮市區` 
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Price_Per_M2) & Price_Per_M2 > 0) %>%
  group_by(Region_Chi, District_Chi) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Unit_Price = mean(Price_Per_M2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 3. Process Aging Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
df_aging_raw <- read_csv(here("data/population_index/aging_index_202412.csv"), skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(df_aging_raw) <- c("CID", "COUNTY", "TID", "TOWN", "M_F", "PH", "PDEN", "DEP_RAT", "YOUNG_RAT", "OLD_RAT", "AGING_IDX", "TIME")

aging_summary <- df_aging_raw %>%
  filter(COUNTY %in% c("臺北市", "新北市", "新竹市", "新竹縣")) %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTY, Raw_District = TOWN) %>%
  mutate(
    Aging_Index = as.numeric(AGING_IDX),
    District_Chi = if_else(Region_Chi == "新竹市", "新竹市", Raw_District)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Region_Chi, District_Chi) %>%
  summarise(Aging_Index = mean(Aging_Index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 4. Integration & Translation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Merge first
final_data_chi <- inner_join(medical_summary, lvr_summary, by = c("Region_Chi", "District_Chi")) %>%
  inner_join(aging_summary, by = c("Region_Chi", "District_Chi"))

# Apply Translation
final_data <- final_data_chi %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Region = translate_region(Region_Chi),
    District = translate_district(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Recalculate Score (Column names might have changed to English in med step if desired, but here we use values)
    # Using the columns from med_summary which are now "Medical Center", "Regional Hospital"...
    Medical_Score = (`Medical Center` * 10) + (`Regional Hospital` * 5) + (`Local Hospital` * 3) + (Clinic * 1) + (Pharmacy * 0.5)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 5. Visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") + # Use Arial for English safety
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

plot_region <- function(data, region_filter, title_text, filename) {
  
  if(!is.null(region_filter)) {
    plot_data <- data %>% filter(Region == region_filter)
  } else {
    plot_data <- data
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Medical_Score, y = Avg_Unit_Price)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Region, size = Aging_Index), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = District), size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 12), name = "Aging Index") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "Bubble Size represents Aging Index (Larger = Older Population)",
      x = "Medical Resource Score",
      y = "Avg. Unit Price (TWD/m², Log Scale)",
      color = "Region"
    ) +
    my_theme
  
  # Add regression line only if enough points
  if(nrow(plot_data) > 2) {
    p <- p + geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", fill = "pink", alpha = 0.2)
  }
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(here(filename), p, width = 10, height = 7, bg = "white")
}

cat("\n[Generating Plots]...\n")

# 1. Combined
plot_region(final_data, NULL, "Housing Price vs. Medical Resources (Combined)", "Plot1_Combined_Eng.png")

# 2. Taipei City
plot_region(final_data, "Taipei City", "Housing Price vs. Medical: Taipei City", "Plot2_Taipei_Eng.png")

# 3. New Taipei City (Requested Addition)
plot_region(final_data, "New Taipei City", "Housing Price vs. Medical: New Taipei City", "Plot3_NewTaipei_Eng.png")

# 4. Hsinchu County
plot_region(final_data, "Hsinchu County", "Housing Price vs. Medical: Hsinchu County", "Plot4_HsinchuCounty_Eng.png")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 6. Notes & Label Index
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 

# A. Hsinchu City Note
note_chi <- "註記：由於公開的實價登錄資料中，新竹市並未詳細區分行政區（東區、北區、香山區），因此將其整合為單一數據點呈現，無法進行個別行政區的迴歸分析。"
note_eng <- "NOTE: Based on public real estate transaction data, Hsinchu City does not have detailed district zoning (East, North, Xiangshan). Therefore, it is aggregated as a single data point, and individual regression analysis cannot be performed."

cat("\n========================================================\n")
cat("               IMPORTANT NOTE (Hsinchu City)            \n")
cat("========================================================\n")
cat(note_chi, "\n\n")
cat(note_eng, "\n")
cat("========================================================\n")

# B. Label Index (Translation Table)
cat("\n\n[Index: Chinese to English Labels]\n")
label_index <- final_data %>%
  select(Region_Chi, Region, District_Chi, District) %>%
  arrange(Region, District) %>%
  distinct()

print(as.data.frame(label_index), row.names = FALSE)

# Save index to CSV for report appendix
write_csv(label_index, here("District_Label_Index.csv"))
cat("\nLabel Index saved to 'District_Label_Index.csv'.\n")







#1143
# ==============================================================================
# 6. Statistical Verification (回歸模型統計數據佐證) - 雙重輸出版
# ==============================================================================

# 定義一個函數：同時 "印出詳細解說" 並 "回傳表格資料列"
get_regression_stats <- function(data, region_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n>>> Analyzing: ", region_name, " <<<\n"))
  
  # 1. 檢查資料筆數是否足夠
  if(nrow(data) < 3) {
    cat("  [Skip] Not enough data points for regression (N < 3).\n")
    if(nrow(data) > 0) {
      cat("  Data Values:\n")
      print(data %>% select(District, Medical_Score, Avg_Unit_Price))
    }
    # 回傳空資料列以保持表格格式
    return(data.frame(
      Region = region_name,
      Equation = "Insufficient Data",
      Slope_Beta1 = NA,
      Change_Per_10_Score_Pct = NA,
      P_Value = NA,
      R_Squared = NA,
      Significance = "N/A"
    ))
  }
  
  # 2. 建立線性模型
  # Model: log10(Price) = Beta0 + Beta1 * Medical_Score
  model <- lm(log10(Avg_Unit_Price) ~ Medical_Score, data = data)
  
  # 3. 提取摘要
  sum_model <- summary(model)
  beta0 <- coef(sum_model)[1, "Estimate"]
  beta1 <- coef(sum_model)["Medical_Score", "Estimate"]
  p_val <- coef(sum_model)["Medical_Score", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  r_sq  <- sum_model$r.squared
  
  # 計算變動百分比
  pct_change <- (10^(beta1 * 10) - 1) * 100
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Part A: 保留您原本的詳細文字解說 (Console Output)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  cat(sprintf("  Regression Equation: log10(Price) = %.4f + %.5f * Medical_Score\n", beta0, beta1))
  cat(sprintf("  Slope (Beta1):       %.5f (每增加1分醫療分數，房價變化的 log10 值)\n", beta1))
  cat(sprintf("  Slope Interpretation: 醫療分數每增加 10 分，房價約變動 %.2f%%\n", pct_change))
  cat(sprintf("  P-value:             %.5f %s\n", p_val, ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "(Significant!)", "(Not Significant)")))
  cat(sprintf("  R-squared:           %.4f (解釋力: %.1f%%)\n", r_sq, r_sq * 100))
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Part B: 回傳整理好的表格資料列 (For Data Frame)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  return(data.frame(
    Region = region_name,
    Equation = sprintf("log(P) = %.2f + %.5f * M", beta0, beta1),
    Slope_Beta1 = beta1,
    Change_Per_10_Score_Pct = round(pct_change, 2), # 百分比變化
    P_Value = p_val,
    R_Squared = r_sq,
    Significance = case_when(
      p_val < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_val < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_val < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  ))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 執行分析
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# 執行函數時，它會直接在螢幕上印出詳細解說
stats_taipei      <- get_regression_stats(final_data %>% filter(Region == "Taipei City"), "Taipei City")
stats_new_taipei  <- get_regression_stats(final_data %>% filter(Region == "New Taipei City"), "New Taipei City")
stats_hsinchu_co  <- get_regression_stats(final_data %>% filter(Region == "Hsinchu County"), "Hsinchu County")
stats_hsinchu_ci  <- get_regression_stats(final_data %>% filter(Region == "Hsinchu City"), "Hsinchu City")
stats_combined    <- get_regression_stats(final_data, "Combined (All Regions)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 產出最終總表 (Table Output)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stats_table_final <- bind_rows(
  stats_taipei, 
  stats_new_taipei, 
  stats_hsinchu_co, 
  stats_hsinchu_ci, 
  stats_combined
)

cat("\n========================================================\n")
cat("               FINAL STATISTICAL SUMMARY TABLE          \n")
cat("========================================================\n")

# 印出漂亮的總表
print(stats_table_final)

# 儲存 CSV
write_csv(stats_table_final, here("Regression_Stats_Summary.csv"))
cat("\nSummary table saved to 'Regression_Stats_Summary.csv'.\n")
```
